purpose: Art-direction reference notes for refinement of v17, not a claim of 3D reconstruction accuracy
source: Four user-attached AI-generated movement videos, inspected at selected frames

videos.role: Idle open-mouth front/side/back triptych; best stable proportion reference
Slow walk triptych, nearly closed-mouth neutral face
Run triptych; shoulder/hip range and soles
Walk, crouch/crawl, climb, grab close-up; strongest face and hand detail evidence

measurement_note: Approximate hand-picked screen-space measurements from the front figure of idle_t050.png. Intended as broad ratio bands, not precise orthographic dimensions. AI clips vary in proportions and finger/teeth configuration over time.
high_priority_morphology_changes_from_v1: Narrower, longer torso and longer legs; reduce toddler-like giant-head/short-leg proportion
Remove separate nose, oval cheek plates, bulging sausage muzzle, eye pupil/highlight objects and visible shoulder balls
Embed smaller warm ivory luminous eyes in cloth surface instead of protruding cyan-white eyeballs
Create a broad real mouth aperture within the head, dark internal cavity and lower jaw integrated into head silhouette
Use asymmetric tapered curved tooth lengths, including larger side canines, in two rows; avoid uniform bead/cone row
Continuous soft sleeves with integrated wrist/palm transitions; no mechanical cuffs or floating sewing rings
Three substantial curved fingers plus thumb, large round tan palm pad, individual pad patches and small ivory claw tips
Feet as a coherent plush paw with three toe lobes/creases; tan underside sole, not white front toe dots or a separate sole disc
Rounded thick plush ears: one upright stitched down its face, one smoothly bent over; no planar slabs or angular triangular tip
Oatmeal/tan oval belly inset with an irregular sewn edge; tan stitches at upper arms, wrists, knees, ears, cheeks and back
Dark indigo short boucle/fleece texture with medium-scale curly breakup; no glossy plastic look or long fur disguising bad forms
rig_and_deformation_requirements: Shoulder and elbow need volume-preserving bend paths for four-limb crawl and forward ledge reach
At least two useful flexion controls per long finger for open palm, ground support and curled ledge grip
Soft ear-base bend plus tip lag rather than rigid segment pivots
Mouth opening must not reveal neck/torso; cheek stitches should not stretch across the opening
Feet need explicit contact/roll testing; short toes and broad plantar support
Body root must move skin, patches, thread, teeth and eyes together
recommended_non_visual_checks: Measure neutral-pose model landmarks normalized to crown-to-floor height and compare against the broad ratio bands
Count connected components and boundary/nonmanifold edges of intended continuous skins; treat cloth overlays separately
Check weight normalization, unweighted vertices, bone-dependent evaluated mesh motion and transform propagation
Stress-test elbow 90/120 degrees, forward shoulder reach, finger curl and crouch; track degenerate faces, extreme stretch and prohibited intersections
Probe mouth opening rays and internal cavity occlusion
Evaluate support-foot minimum Z and endpoint equality of walk loop; do not equate this with foot-lock approval
Use neutral clay orthographic front/side/back views and material views as a final necessary art-direction check
